info.title: Portal Research Progress API
info.description: P11 same-origin progress, bounded structured console, SSE and cooperative cancellation contracts. PostgreSQL materialises a source-owned structured journal. The browser receives neither private source transport metadata nor a worker fencing handle.

get.summary: Read the compact durable progress snapshot for one Research run

200.description: Current durable snapshot or an honest pending-source state

403.description: Reserved access-policy refusal (RESEARCH_PROGRESS_FORBIDDEN). This Control API revision answers a non-member with 404 so a run's existence is not disclosed; an edge access policy may still answer 403 before the request reaches it. Clients render DENIED.

get.summary: Open one bounded same-origin SSE progress stream
get.description: Last-Event-ID is an optional numeric progress sequence when after_seq is absent. Terminal, auth-expired and gap frames close the stream; the client must use snapshot polling rather than retrying indefinitely.

200.description: SSE frames named research.progress.snapshot, research.progress, research.progress.heartbeat, research.progress.gap or auth.expired

403.description: Reserved access-policy refusal (RESEARCH_PROGRESS_FORBIDDEN). This Control API revision answers a non-member with 404 so a run's existence is not disclosed; an edge access policy may still answer 403 before the request reaches it. Clients render DENIED.

get.summary: Read at most 500 explicit structured console observations
get.description: Console observations are worker-emitted structured event payloads only; Portal never derives Research state by parsing process output.

403.description: Reserved access-policy refusal (RESEARCH_PROGRESS_FORBIDDEN). This Control API revision answers a non-member with 404 so a run's existence is not disclosed; an edge access policy may still answer 403 before the request reaches it. Clients render DENIED.

get.summary: Read the immutable requested spec a new run may start from (Screen 02 ?from=)
get.description: CG-P11-07. Read-only and immutable: the P08 manifest row cannot be updated. It returns no preflight token, snapshot locator, lease or worker handle. Creating the new run is still a NEW intent through a fresh preflight; run-create keeps refusing every other intent kind. Dark with the run producer (503).

200.description: The run's requested spec as admitted

403.description: Reserved access-policy refusal (RESEARCH_PROGRESS_FORBIDDEN). This Control API revision answers a non-member with 404 so a run's existence is not disclosed; an edge access policy may still answer 403 before the request reaches it. Clients render DENIED.

409.description: RESEARCH_RUN_REQUESTED_SPEC_NOT_RETAINED: the run exists but its requested spec is not retained

post.summary: ADMIN-only cooperative cancellation of the current durable run
post.description: P11 records one database cancellation compare-and-set then requests a narrow source marker. A pending marker is truthful and does not activate retry or arbitrary commands.

202.description: Cancellation has a durable outcome or pending source-marker reconciliation

Problem.description: Typed same-origin refusal. No private source transport, worker handle, secret, process output or artifact-store location is disclosed.

reader_href.description: P11 has no artifact reader route; a later named, authorized reader contract owns links.

ProgressFoldSegment.description: A source-observed per-fold phase. Times are never inferred from whole-fold events.

ProgressFoldTimeline.description: Current P04 is truthfully NOT_PUBLISHED until a source emits actual per-fold segment facts. COMPLETE means search, OOS and freeze tick are all source-observed and done.

ProgressMethodologyCertificate.description: Methodology A–D certificate fact only. It is distinct from the engine L0–L4 capability axis and must never be derived from claim text or a ceiling.

ProgressSnapshot.description: Compact current projection, capped at 256 KiB by source, ingress and PostgreSQL. It is not an artifact or full-history transport.

overall.description: Server-derived from source facts, never estimated by the browser. pct is stage-weighted and monotonic: S1 5, S2 8, S3 10, the trial study 10 + 70 x trials_done / trials_declared, S4 closed 85, sealing 90, S5 closed 95, 100 only at run_completed. eta_s is the remaining search time at the observed trial rate while trials remain, otherwise null. tqdm_line is a server-built line.

fold_timeline.description: Optional only for a pre-amendment historical snapshot; absence has the documented NOT_PUBLISHED meaning and is not permission to synthesize segments.

selection.description: CG-P11-03. Optional only for a pre-W2 historical snapshot; absence means NOT_PUBLISHED.

methodology_certificate.description: Optional only for a pre-amendment historical snapshot; it must not be inferred from the claim text, engine capability or a methodology ceiling.

handoff_cursor.description: CG-P11-03. The structured cursor from run_completed, set whether or not a claim was issued; `cursor` stays the legacy free text of an issued claim. Optional only for a pre-W2 snapshot; absence means null.

ProgressRetainedArtifact.description: One retained table in the artifact authority's six-state lifecycle. Carries no storage locator, worker attempt, lease epoch or manifest digest.

reader_href.description: No artifact reader route is published; a later named, authorized reader contract owns links.

ProgressTrialPayload.description: Exactly one of `fold` (a fold-bound trial) or `study: GLOBAL` (a trial of one study that scores every fold at once, which therefore names no fold). Ingress rejects both or neither.

objective.description: This trial's objective; null for a pruned or failed trial.

best_objective.description: The study's best objective after this trial; null before any trial completes.

eta_s.description: Remaining search seconds at the observed trial rate; null when not computable (no completed trial yet, or the search is done).

reader_href.description: P11 has no artifact reader route; a later named, authorized reader contract owns links.

ProgressUsage.description: CG-P11-09. Every key is present; null means the source had no probe for that quantity. A zero is a measurement, never a placeholder.

peak_rss_bytes.description: The child's own peak resident set size when it reports one; null when unobservable.

cpu_seconds.description: Profile-bounded: a P04 fixed-qualification attempt is refused above 45 at ingest; a Delta WFO attempt above 120. Null when no child ran (e.g. cancelled before start).

scratch_bytes.description: No peak-scratch probe is installed for the P06 child; null.

fd_peak.description: No descriptor high-water probe is installed for the P06 child; null.

ProgressHandoffCursor.description: CG-P11-03. The fold, trial and parameter bundle a finished run hands to Screen 04 (`#fold=&trial=&params=`). Trial is the 1-based P11 ordinal (source trial number + 1). params_digest is sha256 over the canonical JSON of the selected parameter bundle.

ProgressFoldSelectionFact.description: CG-P11-03. The parameter bundle a fold was evaluated with. GLOBAL_STUDY: one optimizer study selected it for every fold, so objective is study-wide, not a per-fold best. FIXED_PROFILE: no search ran; objective is null.

ProgressFoldSelection.description: Snapshot form of ProgressFoldSelectionFact. NOT_PUBLISHED until the source's fold_completed carries a selection.

evidence_digest.description: CG-P11-09. sha256 of the P13 terminal evidence receipt that travels beside this event at the private ingress (P04 fixed profile only).

split_digest.description: CG-P11-09. sha256 of the P14 terminal split receipt that travels beside this event at the private ingress (P04 fixed profile only).

ProgressEvent.description: Typed public event union. The browser may narrow by event_type without parsing arbitrary source strings; ingress independently rejects unknown keys.

ProgressAttempt.description: At most eight worker attempts. Ordinal and immutable scheduler-event timestamps only; no worker identity, lease epoch or source locator.

ended_at_utc_ms.description: For LOST_LEASE: when the scheduler's expired-lease sweep recorded the loss, which can be long after the lease lapsed.

lease_expired_at_utc_ms.description: CG-P11-06. When a LOST_LEASE attempt's lease actually lapsed (the attempt's last expires_at); null for every other state. Optional during additive client rollout.

ProgressRunIdentity.description: CG-P11-03. Stored facts from the P10 producer row and its immutable P08 manifest; nothing is derived from progress. No display id is minted as an identity: run_id is the identity. display_label (D1) is a derived presentation label, never an identity and never accepted as input.

display_label.description: D1: the short label the hi-fi prints (`R-WFO-118`) - the run's execution profile kind plus its position among the logical runs of that kind in this workspace, ordered by creation (run_id breaks a tie). Server-derived so two readers cannot disagree; presentation only - run_id remains the identity and is the only value a request may carry. null when no label can be derived, and the reader prints the short id rather than a guess.

engine_release_id.description: The engine release the P02 client requested (requested_spec.client.engine_release_id).

declared_folds.description: The fold count the P08 topology declared at admission (a three-window run declares one).

ProgressDeniedArtifact.description: CG-P11-03. A declared artifact this viewer may not read. Today only the P08 sealed holdout: its window and bar count are manifest metadata; its values were never given to the child and no unlock workflow is installed.

RunRequestedSpec.description: CG-P11-07. The immutable requested spec a run was admitted with.

requested_spec.description: Exactly the research.requested-spec.v1 document the run was admitted with.

ProgressFailedAt.description: E10. The stage (and fold, when the source marked one FAILED) at which a failed run stopped.

basis.description: SOURCE_RUNNING_STAGE: the last snapshot had this stage RUNNING. FIRST_UNFINISHED_STAGE: no stage was running; this is the first stage that never completed, so the run stopped before it started.

origin.description: SOURCE: the worker reported the failure. CONTROL: the Portal scheduler closed the run (lost lease, undispatched retry, unrecordable terminal sidecar).

run.description: CG-P11-03. Optional during additive client rollout; the server emits it on every read (null only if the producer row could not be read).

queue.description: Optional during additive client rollout; current server emits it on every read. retry_not_before_utc_ms is set only while the job is in RETRY_WAIT (CG-P11-06).

attempts.description: Optional during additive client rollout; current server emits [] before any claim.

terminal_materialization.description: Optional during additive RS-01 client rollout; server emits it for every current read.

retry_reason.description: CG-P11-07. No automatic or in-place retry exists. The one action is a new run seeded from GET /api/v1/research/runs/{runId}/requested-spec. P12_OWNED_NO_P11_RETRY_ROUTE is only ever emitted by a pre-W2 server.

new_run_from.description: CG-P11-07. Whether this run's requested spec is retained to seed a new run. Optional during additive client rollout.

failed_at.description: E10. Where a FAILED run stopped, derived by the server from its last persisted snapshot (the same derivation the Run Library trail uses). Null unless effective_status is FAILED and a snapshot exists. Optional during additive client rollout; the server emits it on every read.

terminal_reason.description: E10. Why a FAILED run failed: the source failure when the source reported one, otherwise the typed control-side reason the scheduler recorded (for example P06_RETRY_NOT_DISPATCHED or P11_TERMINAL_SIDECAR_FAILED). Null unless effective_status is FAILED. Optional during additive client rollout; the server emits it on every read.

retained_artifacts.description: RF01-B3. The run's retained P05 tables from the artifact authority, ordered by table_kind then artifact identity, bounded at 128. A different set from progress.artifacts (bundle readiness journaled by the source); only here can CORRUPT or MISSING appear. Optional during additive client rollout; the server emits it for every current read, as [] when no table is retained yet.

denied_artifacts.description: CG-P11-03. Declared artifacts this viewer may not read, never linked. Optional during additive client rollout; [] when none.

ProgressStreamEvent.description: CG-P11-08 (DQ-13). A live frame carries this viewer's current read, materialised once after the event committed, so the browser never refetches per event. A replayed frame (sequence at or below the opening research.progress.snapshot) carries read: null because the opening frame is already current. A read over 192 KiB is omitted with read_omitted_reason and the client makes one snapshot GET.

read.description: Optional during additive client rollout; the server writes it on every research.progress frame.
